title: Localization check
summary: Test that finds player text built without tr() (formatted/concatenated UI text, .tscn text with auto-translate off), with an allowlist and a runtime translation check
claude_md: - `tests/l10n/check_strings.gd` (suite `l10n`, part of --changed) fails on UI text formatted or concatenated without `tr()`; exceptions in `tests/l10n/l10n_allowlist.gd`.
